plain_english: A prospective four-probe diagnostic schedule eliminated five-way confident errors relative to fixed and random in matched common16 but gave 208/256 correct versus 232/256 fixed and 218/256 random, abstaining 48 vs 18 fixed. It fails the precommitted >=3pp correct gain by -9.375pp versus best fixed. This is a safety-coverage tradeoff, not source evidence of better causal learning. Do not revise score/source/thresholds after outcome. Equal-information flat symbolic ties candidate. No original CausalGym original first-use.
